name: Manahat
title: Descendant of Seir the Horite
summary: Manahat was a son of Zibeon, who was a descendant of Seir the Horite. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as part of the Horite tribal people who lived in the region of Seir (Edom) before the Edomites took over the land. The name Manahat is also associated with a place or clan mentioned in connection with the descendants of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Seir's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Manahat is mentioned as one of the sons of Zibeon, who was a son of Seir the Horite, among the original inhabitants of the Edom region.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in the genealogy of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Manahat is mentioned again in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles as part of Seir's descendants, confirming his place in the history of the Horites.

keyEvents.title: Horite chiefs in Seir
keyEvents.description: The Horites, including Shobal's clan to which Manahat belonged, are listed as tribal chiefs who lived in the land of Seir before being displaced by Esau's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Seir's sons as chiefs
keyEvents.description: Shobal's clan, of which Manahat was a part, is counted among the Horite chiefs who held influence in the Seir region during the time of the patriarchs.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Edom and Esau's territory
keyEvents.description: The Seir region, where Manahat's family lived, was later taken over by Esau's descendants (the Edomites), placing Manahat in an important geopolitical context within the biblical narrative.
